cues: Pick a direction to walk round the loop.
A resistor walked along the assumed current gives minus I R; against it, plus I R.
A cell walked from minus to plus gives plus E; from plus to minus, minus E. Set the total to zero.
And if a current comes out negative, it just flows the other way.
The size is still right, so never redraw.
